channel.title: Cork Safety Alerts - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Cork Safety Alerts (corksafetyalerts.com)

item.title: Pedestrian Knocked Down in Innishannon
item.description: Reports a pedestrian has been knocked down on the N71 Innishannon near Centra. Emergency services are on scene. Take care on approach.

item.title: Collision on N40 Eastbound
item.description: Reports of a collision, eastbound, on the N40 South Ring Road between Junction 10 (Mahon) and Jack Lynch Tunnel / Junction 11 (Dunkettle). Take care on approach.

item.title: Breakdown on N40 Westbound
item.description: Reports of a breakdown, westbound, on the N40 South Ring Road between Junction 11 (M8/N25) Dunkettle and Jack Lynch Tunnel East Entrance (Cork). Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 2 March at 16:06.

item.title: Collision on R610 Infirmary Road
item.description: Reports of a collision on the R610 Infirmary Road, Cork City near City General Hospital. Take care on approach.

item.title: Pedestrian Knocked Down at Marina
item.description: Reports a pedestrian has been knocked down at Northcliffe, Marina. Emergency services are en route. Take care on approach.

item.title: Debris on N25
item.description: Reports of debris on the N25 between Castlemartyr and Loughaderra Lake. Take care on approach.

item.title: 12,000 Coloured Balls Set to Race Down Patrick's Hill for Cork First Responders
item.description: 12,000 coloured balls will race down Patrick's Hill on 15 March at 2pm raising funds for Cork's first responders. Balls just €2 at corklionsclub.ie

item.title: Community Safety Initiative Launched in North Cork with Government Backing
item.description: A new community safety initiative has launched in Charleville, backed by Government funding to support families in North Cork's most disadvantaged areas.

item.title: Fota Wildlife Park's Panoramic Wheel Returns on 14 March
item.description: Fota Wildlife Park's 35m Panoramic Wheel returns on 14 March, offering stunning views across the Park, Cork Harbour and beyond.

item.title: ⚠️ Freezing Road Surfaces: 1°C Reported
